proposed_facts.reason: Canonical copy entry supplies ThrownCopyStar and true to shared initialization. Both Drink callers enter the victim state before copy-kind selection and processing. The document consistently preserves this ordering.

The installed callback implements the stated unclamped arithmetic on saved root-scale components. Recovery physics distinguishes timer-dependent ordinary recovery from unconditional copy recovery on its next invocation. Endpoint sampling, finite duration and monotonic enlargement are appropriately not asserted.

The normal guard precedes lbVector_Mirror, whose canonical definition modifies only XY without normalization. Recovery requires a strictly negative XY dot product. The x8 assignment follows the completed recovery entry and therefore cannot affect velocity setup already performed inside that call.

The canonical helper uses distinct union expressions for X and Y, changes facing only in the greater-than branch, and clears only X otherwise. Timer subtraction precedes GrabMash and the nonpositive release comparison. The proposal correctly avoids assuming alias equivalence or positive tuning.

contradictions.reason: Accept unresolved dispositions for all six small-data facts: source ordering expressions and MUST_MATCH assertions do not establish emitted section contents, layout or consumers. The embedded-field address assertion is not an ordinary nullable output-pointer guard.

Accept deferral of Girl identification and cleanup-helper semantics in the selection and broad functionality claims. The exact unsigned predicate is proved, not the expanded second kind. Ability-loss wording must preserve the copy outcome, Kirby kind, marker and !hat.x8_b0 guards.
Accept superseding the acquisition-order claim: ground and air Drink invoke victim entry before selecting and processing the copy kind.

Accept unresolved invariant-deceleration claims and the exact-branch replacement. Uniform speed reduction needs alias and tuning evidence. Equality takes the X-only fallback; facing and Y are unchanged there. This also justifies retaining uncertainty in the broad transition-chain and functionality claims.

Accept the scale-related unresolved dispositions and replacement, including the unresolved scaling link. xC is a coefficient, not a duration. Neither bounded interpolation, progressive restoration, monotonic enlargement nor endpoint invocation is guaranteed. Copy recovery exits without waiting for its timer. External collision semantics remain deferred.

Accept deferral of complete damage callback dispatch and exceptional-exit ordering. Local installation of both slots and the unconditional forwarding body are proved, but those facts alone do not establish all framework invocation paths.

Accept unresolved later release significance for x8, unresolved head-on-only wording, and the XY reflection replacement. Reflection is guarded by any nonzero normal component, while only recovery uses the negative-dot-product test. Both collision callbacks assign x8 after recovery entry.

Accept unresolved thrower-derived-scale wording: the saved root scale and accessory scaling attribute are victim-side. Stored thrower-pointer and accessory ownership and cleanup lifetimes remain explicitly deferred rather than inferred from helper names.

Accept the unresolved IASA link with its original record preserved. An empty endpoint proves no local input-driven transition, not general prevention of interruption; copy-star physics still calls GrabMash. The state table confirms the association without proving immunity.
